timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So wait, Entra ID is just Azure AD with a new name? Why rebrand at all?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Because Azure AD does way more than directory services now. Entra is the whole identity fabric.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Okay but how is it different from regular Active Directory?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: AD lives on your servers. Entra ID lives in the cloud — globally distributed, no domain controllers needed.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about service principals? That sounds made up.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They're identities for apps and services. Think of them as the app equivalent of a user account.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Azure handles the credentials for you. No secrets in code, no rotation headaches. Beautiful.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What if we're still running on-prem AD though?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: That's hybrid identity. Entra Connect syncs your local directory to the cloud seamlessly.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So you can use both at the same time?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Most enterprises run hybrid for years during migration. It's the norm, not the exception.
